metadata.title: Suppressing hot gas accretion to supermassive black holes by stellar winds

notes: No individual star is identified or studied as a Galactic unbound candidate. The paper refers generically to high-velocity and AGB stars and to the Galactic SMBH Sgr A* (e.g., T:p2-b6, T:p4-b3, T:p5-b8), but establishes no stellar Galactic-unbound candidacy.
